alt: A close-up of a sculpted diorama featuring a tan leather pouch adorned with intricate beadwork and a turquoise stone, surrounded by a feather, antler, and smooth river stones.
A sculpted cake diorama features a sculpted bear-shaped cave with a white paw print, surrounded by miniature woven baskets, a beaded necklace, and scattered pebbles on a wooden base.
A sculpted cake bear head display features a pair of beaded moccasins, a woven basket, a pipe, and feathers arranged on a patterned blanket.

A sculpted cake diorama on a wooden base depicts a textured, grey rock formation surrounded by Native American artifacts, including a beaded bag, a horn, a feather, a woven basket, and a painted bowl.

A sculpted cake diorama depicts a rustic still life scene featuring a woven basket with a lid, a beaded necklace, a small bowl with leaves, and a pair of moccasins arranged on a patterned blanket and fur.
A sculpted cake diorama features a beaded Native American pouch and antler resting on a sculpted base with stones and a tree root.
A sculpted cake bear head mounted on a wooden plaque, surrounded by Native American artifacts including moccasins, a beaded pouch, a feather, a pipe, and a woven basket.
A pair of beaded Native American moccasins, a feather, a pipe, and a bear head sculpture are arranged on a decorative tray.
A small, woven basket with red and black geometric patterns holds a cluster of green leaves, resting on a patterned surface alongside other craft items.

A close-up of a tan leather pouch adorned with a central circular pattern of black, red, and light blue beads surrounding a light blue stone, flanked by two curved rows of white bone beads and topped with a small turtle charm.

A collection of smooth, polished stones in various colors and patterns rests on a sandy surface next to a bundle of dried green leaves tied with twine, with a textured gray sculpture in the background.

A sculpted cake wooden bowl with black geometric patterns and a central turtle motif, filled with red berries, green leaves, and small white flowers, surrounded by natural elements like stones, twigs, and dried plants on a textured surface.
